lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in quasi-vertical columns posterior to the gill region; spots exhibit increasing diameter and spatial separation toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying sharp vertical intensity transitions with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs bounded within the trailing silhouette of the dorsal fin visible at the upper-right periphery.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small-diameter high-luminance spots localized on the distal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
